claim: A two-lane 3090 foundry, a constrained 4060 HALO3 node, heterogeneous personal nodes, an unfamiliar peripheral, a passive physical continuity floor, and an independent evidence node can establish the marginal value, degradation law, substitution behavior, and complete replayability of civilization-to-cell capability while Fable and Kimi3 are fingerprinted under one hidden-graded contract.

claims.acceptance: The same task constitution deterministically yields one bounded cartridge set with explicit omissions, fallbacks, authority, and resource budgets.
claims.negative_control: Remove dependency identities or permit a foundry model to redefine acceptance after task disclosure.
claims.title: Civilization compiles a bounded mission loadout before field execution

claims.acceptance: Every arm runs the same frozen family and condition cells, retains its proper identity mode, and records outcome, cost, attention, degradation, and escaped-defect evidence without aggregate ranking.
claims.negative_control: Erase the model identity envelope, expose the hidden grader, or average incompatible task families into one score.
claims.title: Fable, Kimi3, and the deterministic control produce comparable operational fingerprints

claims.acceptance: The personal node completes one bounded local action, the independent witness observes the expected result, and loss of HALO3 changes nothing.
claims.negative_control: Replace the observed physical outcome with a model statement or successful process exit.
claims.title: One personal node can sense, decide within authority, and verify a harmless local effect without HALO3

claims.acceptance: The nodes share one attributed state frontier, preserve role-specific apertures, and continue with an explicit capability reduction when one head is removed.
claims.negative_control: Let one role projection rewrite shared truth or describe separate accelerators as pooled memory.
claims.title: Three heterogeneous personal nodes form one coherent cell without sharing all data or memory

claims.acceptance: Adding HALO3 improves at least one accepted-work, attention, translation, recovery, or external-byte dimension with no consequential-miss increase, and removing it leaves the survival floor intact.
claims.negative_control: Count fluent output, GPU utilization, or lower latency as advantage without a verified change in human decision or physical outcome.
claims.title: The constrained 4060 HALO3 node adds measurable cell advantage without owning survival

claims.acceptance: The operator authorizes one mission-scoped adapter, a reversible challenge proves the mapping, and disconnect or lease expiry removes the capability without corrupting shared state.
claims.negative_control: Infer permanent trust from proximity, accept an unobserved action, or let the model grant its own device authority.
claims.title: A named human can bind an unfamiliar system into the cell with bounded reversible authority

claims.acceptance: Each island retains identity, accepted state, local authority, evidence, and basic human access while remote facts become visibly stale or unavailable.
claims.negative_control: Allow the best-connected branch to overwrite the other branch or hide synchronization age.
claims.title: A partitioned cell continues as smaller valid subcells without silent authority or history loss

claims.acceptance: Forced HALO3 loss removes only declared synthesis and attention breadth, while the cell retains accepted state, authority, evidence, local communication, and resumable tasks.
claims.negative_control: Store the only current state, authority, or reattachment packet inside the HALO3 model process.
claims.title: HALO3 is an accelerator that can be powered off without destroying mission state or authority

claims.acceptance: The successor rehydrates the exact pending decision, evidence, mandate, and next actions while the missing node remains absent.
claims.negative_control: Reconstruct the task from transcript memory or transfer role authority without a named handoff.
claims.title: A lost personal node can be succeeded without inventing a new mission identity or losing custody

claims.acceptance: With active mesh and HALO3 absent, the operator can recover the mission identity, rendezvous or next action, and the path to richer evidence from the passive floor.
claims.negative_control: Treat a printed or optical mark as current state without identity, epoch, or human interpretation rules.
claims.title: A passive physical floor preserves minimum viable legibility when active digital bearers disappear

claims.acceptance: Both branches remain inspectable, conflicts and staleness are explicit, and only a named authority records the reconciliation disposition.
claims.negative_control: Choose the newest, most prestigious, or most connected branch automatically.
claims.title: Reconnection preserves divergent histories and requires explicit disposition of conflict

claims.acceptance: A clean verifier reconstructs the plan, every accepted and rejected claim, every cue and action, every fault and recovery, and the final proof matrix from content-addressed artifacts.
claims.negative_control: Retain dashboards and logs while losing exact bytes, validators, identity, or outcome receipts.
claims.title: The entire campaign can be reconstructed without trusting the original model session or operator narration

faults.recovery: Queue attributed deltas locally and reconcile after the route returns.
faults.title: Remove WAN and all reachback routes

faults.recovery: Resume from the last sealed cell anchor under a fresh HALO3 treatment.
faults.title: Power off the HALO3 4060 process and device path

faults.recovery: Transfer the named role and custody to a qualified successor through an explicit handoff.
faults.title: Remove the current leader head

faults.recovery: Continue from accepted artifacts or reroute a fresh bounded crate to another admitted supplier.
faults.title: Kill the Kimi3 runtime after planning

faults.recovery: Preserve both branches and require explicit reconciliation.
faults.title: Inject a delayed and contradictory shared-state observation

faults.recovery: Expire the live capability and require a new bind and reversible challenge after reconnect.
faults.title: Disconnect the unfamiliar peripheral during use

faults.recovery: Reject the candidate cartridge and restore the last verified content identity.
faults.title: Mutate or truncate the mission cartridge

faults.recovery: Remain held until a current named human supplies the required event.
faults.title: Remove the required human acknowledgment

models.title: Fable provider-observed frontier model

notes: The two 3090 lanes are separate logical treatments. Physical failure-domain independence remains unclaimed until the estate census proves distinct hosts, power paths, and storage custody.
physical_boundary: The topology, stages, faults, and proof predicates are declared and provider-free qualified only after the accompanying deterministic tests pass. No host, GPU, model runtime, sensor, peripheral, energy measurement, radio-loss condition, human-use outcome, or physical action is qualified until exact target-machine observations and independent outcome receipts populate the generated templates.

stages.acceptance: A clean deterministic replay produces the same bounded cartridge identities and refuses the corrupted treatment.
stages.intervention: Compile the task constitution into mission, role, environment, equipment, integration, contingency, and attention cartridges.
stages.title: Foundry compile

stages.acceptance: Every cell remains identity-bound, hidden-graded, costed, and free of model-owned acceptance.
stages.intervention: Run Fable, Kimi3, and the deterministic control across every frozen family under baseline and degraded conditions.
stages.title: Model fingerprint

stages.acceptance: The independent witness observes the expected result and reconciles it to the exact authorized intent.
stages.intervention: Run one harmless sensing and action loop on a personal node without HALO3.
stages.title: Single personal node

stages.acceptance: The cell shares state without implicit memory pooling, role leakage, or one head becoming truth authority.
stages.intervention: Join three heterogeneous personal nodes into one attributed shared frontier with role-specific projections.
stages.title: Cell union

stages.acceptance: The matched vector improves on accepted work, attention, translation, recovery, or external bytes with no consequential-miss increase.
stages.intervention: Add the constrained 4060 HALO3 node and compare the same task against the cell-only baseline.
stages.title: HALO3 enhancement

stages.acceptance: The adapter works only inside the declared scope, disconnect expires capability, and no model mints authority.
stages.intervention: Bind an unfamiliar peripheral through a named human, discovered interface, reversible challenge, and scoped lease.
stages.title: Human-scoped foreign bind

stages.acceptance: Each island retains the survival floor and records visible staleness, conflict, and branch identity.
stages.intervention: Split the active cell into islands while injecting one delayed contradictory observation.
stages.title: Cell partition

stages.acceptance: Only the declared HALO3 advantage disappears; mission state, authority, evidence, and basic human access remain.
stages.intervention: Power off HALO3 during the admitted mission and continue from sealed cell state.
stages.title: HALO3 removal

stages.acceptance: The successor reattaches to the exact decision and custody chain without transcript reconstruction.
stages.intervention: Remove the current leader head and transfer the pending decision to a successor.
stages.title: Head succession

stages.acceptance: A human decodes the bounded passive state and reaches the correct reattachment surface without treating the mark as live truth.
stages.intervention: Disable active digital bearers and use the passive physical floor to recover mission identity and next action.
stages.title: Passive continuity

stages.acceptance: Both branches remain inspectable and only a named authority resolves consequential conflict.
stages.intervention: Reconnect the partitioned cell and present both histories to a named authority.
stages.title: Branch reconciliation

stages.acceptance: The clean replay reproduces the plan, identities, observations, acceptances, refusals, faults, recoveries, and proof matrix.
stages.intervention: Reconstruct the entire campaign from a clean verifier using exact artifacts, hidden graders, and outcome receipts.
stages.title: Complete replay
